claims.evidence: No capacity marking or stamp visible on cylinder body or valve collar in Photo 0.

claims.claim: direct tokunbo (foreign-used, implying good imported condition)
claims.evidence: No origin marking, import sticker, or manufacturer stamp visible; wear and rust are consistent with age but do not confirm origin or quality claim.

risks.risk: Actual capacity may differ from stated 20kg (could be 12.5kg, 15kg, or 25kg)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the valve collar or shoulder stamp showing capacity in kg
risks.if_unproven: priced as the smallest common cylinder size (12.5kg) until capacity is confirmed

risks.risk: Valve may not hold pressure or could be leaking
risks.proof: Video or photo of a soap-bubble leak test on the valve under pressure

risks.risk: Internal corrosion or rust compromising safety
risks.proof: Photo of interior via valve removal or a current hydrostatic test certificate

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty or only partially filled
risks.proof: Photo of weighing scale with cylinder and tare weight visible

risks.risk: No valid inspection or recertification date
risks.proof: Photo of stamped manufacture/inspection date on the cylinder neck

risks.risk: Regulator or hose not included despite common bundling expectation
risks.proof: Photo showing regulator and hose included with the cylinder
risks.if_unproven: priced as cylinder only, no accessories

proof_requests: Close-up photo of valve collar/shoulder showing capacity stamp (kg)
Video of pressure/leak test on valve
Photo of cylinder on a weighing scale
Photo confirming inclusion (or absence) of regulator and hose
response.reason: The item type (LPG cylinder) is confirmed by the witness, but capacity, fill level, valve integrity, and certification are all unverifiable from the photo, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
